<!doctype html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Mini-corso gratuito in 8 video per titolari di studio dentistico: team, numeri, processi, patient journey e intelligenza artificiale.">
  <title>Da Studio a Impresa 2027 | Dental Business Model</title>
  <style>

:root {
  --navy: #07192b;
  --navy-2: #0b243a;
  --blue: #1d577f;
  --cyan: #38b5c8;
  --cyan-soft: #9ce8ee;
  --paper: #f5f3ed;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --ink: #102238;
  --muted: #637384;
  --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--navy);
  color: var(--white);
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
button, input { font: inherit; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
main { overflow: hidden; }

.topbar {
  background: var(--cyan);
  color: #052035;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 9px 20px;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.site-header {
  height: 92px;
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 30px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
}
.brand img { width: 178px; height: auto; display: block; }
.site-header nav { display: flex; gap: 34px; }
.site-header nav a {
  color: #b9c8d6;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: color .2s;
}
.site-header nav a:hover { color: var(--cyan-soft); }
.site-header > .button { justify-self: end; }
.button {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 22px;
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, background .2s;
}
.button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.button svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }
.button-small { padding: 12px 17px; background: transparent; color: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); }
.button-primary { background: var(--cyan); color: #062137; }

.course-banner {
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 38px auto 0;
  padding: 0 30px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 4;
}
.course-banner img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  object-fit: cover;
  border: 1px solid rgba(156,232,238,.22);
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 32px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

.hero {
  min-height: 720px;
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 78px 30px 105px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.14fr) minmax(360px, .72fr);
  gap: 72px;
  align-items: start;
  position: relative;
}
.hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -92px 58% 0 -35vw;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(22, 68, 101, .5), transparent);
  transform: skewX(-10deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero::after {
  content: "";
  width: 520px; height: 520px;
  position: absolute; right: -270px; top: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56,181,200,.13);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 75px rgba(56,181,200,.025), 0 0 0 150px rgba(56,181,200,.018);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-glow {
  position: absolute; width: 420px; height: 420px;
  left: 32%; top: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(56,181,200,.1), transparent 67%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-copy, .hero-form { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.eyebrow {
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  color: var(--cyan-soft);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.eyebrow span { width: 28px; height: 1px; background: var(--cyan); }
.eyebrow.dark { color: var(--blue); }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
h1 {
  max-width: 730px;
  margin-bottom: 27px;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: clamp(50px, 5.2vw, 78px);
  line-height: .99;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: -.045em;
}
h1 em, h2 em { color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 400; }
.hero-lead {
  max-width: 610px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  color: #bdcbd7;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.hero-list { display: grid; gap: 13px; max-width: 610px; }
.hero-list > div { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; color: #dbe5ed; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
.check {
  flex: none;
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(56,181,200,.55); border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--cyan);
}
.check svg { width: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; }
.signup-form {
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--ink);
  padding: 34px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.form-heading { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.form-heading span { color: var(--blue); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.form-heading strong { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; }
.signup-form label:not(.privacy) { display: block; margin-bottom: 15px; }
.signup-form label > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .05em; }
.signup-form input[type="text"], .signup-form input[type="email"] {
  width: 100%; height: 51px;
  border: 1px solid #d9e0e5; border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0 15px; outline: none; color: var(--ink); background: #fbfcfc;
  transition: border .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
.signup-form input:focus { border-color: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56,181,200,.12); }
.privacy { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 17px 1fr; gap: 10px; margin: 19px 0; color: #687583; }
.privacy input { margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: var(--blue); }
.privacy span { font-size: 10px !important; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 500 !important; letter-spacing: 0 !important; }
.signup-form .button { width: 100%; }
.form-note { margin: 12px 0 0; color: #7a8792; font-size: 9px; text-align: center; }
.form-success {
  min-height: 340px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px;
  background: white; color: var(--ink); padding: 35px; border-radius: 8px;
}
.form-success > span { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #dff7f7; color: #0b7a86; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 22px; }
.form-success strong { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; }
.form-success p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
.delera-form-shell {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 855px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--white);
  box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.delera-form-shell iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 855px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.hero-metric {
  position: absolute; z-index: 3; bottom: 34px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #9cb0c2;
}
.hero-metric span { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 47px; color: white; }
.hero-metric p { margin: 0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.metric-one { left: 30px; }
.metric-two { left: 180px; }
.mobile-cta { display: none; }

.section-light { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }
.intro-video { padding: 110px max(30px, calc((100vw - 1180px)/2)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: .78fr 1.22fr; gap: 86px; align-items: center; }
.section-heading h2, .problem h2, .lessons-intro h2, .method h2, .audience h2, .final-cta h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(42px, 4.3vw, 64px); line-height: 1.03; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.035em;
}
.section-heading > p:last-child { color: var(--muted); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; }
.video-shell {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e2d48, #071828);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(7,25,43,.2);
}
.video-shell iframe {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
}
.video-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(56,181,200,.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(56,181,200,.1) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 52px 52px; mask-image: linear-gradient(135deg, black, transparent); }
.play-button {
  position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  width: 76px; height: 76px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: white; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); cursor: pointer;
}
.play-button span { padding-left: 4px; }
.video-caption { position: absolute; left: 28px; bottom: 25px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.video-caption span { color: var(--cyan-soft); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.video-caption strong { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 400; }

.problem { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 120px 30px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr .85fr; gap: 90px; }
.problem-copy { color: #aebfcd; padding-top: 40px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; }
.problem-copy .large { color: white; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.45; }
.problem-copy strong { color: var(--cyan-soft); }
.problem blockquote {
  grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 25px 0 0; padding: 34px 50px 34px 100px; border: 1px solid rgba(56,181,200,.24);
  position: relative; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 38px); line-height: 1.35;
}
.problem blockquote > span { position: absolute; left: 34px; top: 13px; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 80px; line-height: 1; }
.problem blockquote strong { display: block; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 400; }

.idea { padding: 120px 30px; }
.centered { max-width: 790px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
.centered .eyebrow { justify-content: center; }
.contrast-grid { max-width: 920px; margin: 65px auto 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 60px 1fr; align-items: center; }
.contrast-card { min-height: 330px; padding: 38px; border: 1px solid #d9dee0; }
.contrast-card.old { background: #ebe9e3; color: #73808b; }
.contrast-card.new { background: var(--navy); color: white; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(7,25,43,.2); }
.card-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 28px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue); }
.new .card-label { color: var(--cyan); }
.contrast-card ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.contrast-card li { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 23px; }
.contrast-card h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 400; }
.contrast-card p { color: #aebfcd; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }
.mini-rule { margin-top: 30px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--cyan-soft); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
.connector { position: relative; z-index: 2; margin: 0 -5px; width: 70px; height: 70px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--cyan); color: var(--navy); border-radius: 50%; }
.connector svg { width: 27px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; }

.stages { padding: 120px 30px; }
.stages .section-heading > p:last-child { color: #9fb1c1; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; }
.stage-grid { max-width: 1180px; margin: 70px auto 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.stage-grid article { min-height: 355px; padding: 30px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); position: relative; transition: background .25s, transform .25s; }
.stage-grid article:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.stage-grid article:hover, .stage-grid article.featured { background: rgba(56,181,200,.08); }
.stage-grid article.featured { box-shadow: inset 0 -3px var(--cyan); }
.stage-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 70px; }
.stage-number { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; color: var(--cyan); }
.stage-focus { padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: #94a9ba; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .15em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.stage-grid h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 27px; font-weight: 400; }
.stage-grid p { color: #9fb0be; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }
.stage-line { position: absolute; left: 30px; right: 30px; bottom: 30px; height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
.stage-line span { display: block; width: 24%; height: 100%; background: var(--cyan); }
.stage-grid article:nth-child(2) .stage-line span { width: 50%; }
.stage-grid article:nth-child(3) .stage-line span { width: 75%; }
.stage-grid article:nth-child(4) .stage-line span { width: 100%; }
.center-cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 48px; }
.center-cta p { margin: 14px 0 0; color: #8299aa; font-size: 10px; }

.lessons { padding: 120px max(30px, calc((100vw - 1180px)/2)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: .78fr 1.22fr; gap: 90px; }
.lessons-intro { position: sticky; top: 40px; align-self: start; }
.lessons-intro > p:last-child { color: var(--muted); max-width: 390px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; }
.lesson-list { border-top: 1px solid #cfd6d9; }
.lesson-list article { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr 30px; gap: 15px; padding: 24px 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd6d9; align-items: start; }
.lesson-list > article > span { color: var(--blue); font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; }
.lesson-list h3 { margin-bottom: 5px; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 400; }
.lesson-list p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; }
.lesson-arrow { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 21px; text-align: right; }

.method { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 120px 30px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: 100px; }
.method-copy > p:not(.eyebrow) { color: #a2b4c3; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; }
.method-word { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 42px; }
.method-word span { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(56,181,200,.35); color: var(--cyan-soft); font-family: Georgia, serif; }
.method-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.method-grid article { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; gap: 15px; padding: 27px 15px 27px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.method-grid article:nth-child(odd) { border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.method-grid article:nth-child(even) { padding-left: 25px; }
.method-grid article > span { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 31px; color: var(--cyan); }
.method-grid h3 { margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 400; }
.method-grid p { margin: 0; color: #8fa4b5; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.55; }

.audience { padding: 120px max(30px, calc((100vw - 1100px)/2)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 80px; }
.section-index { display: block; margin-bottom: 30px; color: var(--blue); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .18em; }
.audience ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 40px 0 0; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.audience li { display: flex; gap: 13px; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; }
.audience .check { color: var(--blue); border-color: rgba(29,87,127,.4); }
.audience-no { background: var(--navy); color: white; padding: 52px; align-self: center; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(7,25,43,.2); }
.audience-no .section-index { color: var(--cyan); }
.audience-no h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 31px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 400; }
.audience-no p { color: #aabcca; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; }

.guides { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 120px 30px; }
.guide-content { margin-top: 70px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: .95fr 1.05fr; gap: 42px; align-items: stretch; }
.founders-photo {
  min-height: 570px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 28%, rgba(56,181,200,.19), transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, #123a57, #061625);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56,181,200,.2);
}
.founders-photo::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.founders-photo img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.guide-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; }
.guide-grid article { padding: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
.role { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .17em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.guide-grid h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 400; }
.guide-grid article > p:last-child { margin: 0; color: #9fb1c0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; }
.guides-note { max-width: 700px; margin: 36px auto 0; color: #96a9b9; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }

.final-cta { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 110px 30px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 420px; gap: 100px; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.final-copy > p:not(.eyebrow) { max-width: 550px; color: #a6b8c6; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; }
.final-seal { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 34px; }
.final-seal span { font-family: Georgia, serif; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 56px; }
.final-seal p { margin: 0; color: #b7c5d0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .11em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; }
.signup-form.compact { box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }

.faq { padding: 120px 30px; }
.faq-list { max-width: 850px; margin: 60px auto 0; border-top: 1px solid #cdd4d7; }
.faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid #cdd4d7; }
.faq summary { list-style: none; padding: 24px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 19px; }
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.faq summary span { color: var(--blue); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; transition: transform .2s; }
.faq details[open] summary span { transform: rotate(45deg); }
.faq details p { max-width: 700px; padding: 0 0 24px; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }

footer { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 65px 30px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr 1fr; align-items: end; gap: 30px; }
footer img { width: 180px; height: auto; object-fit: contain; }
.footer-message { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; text-align: center; color: #8ea4b5; font-family: Georgia, serif; }
.footer-message strong { color: var(--cyan-soft); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; }
.footer-meta { text-align: right; color: #7890a2; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .site-header { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; }
  .site-header nav { display: none; }
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 45px; padding-top: 55px; }
  .hero-copy { max-width: 760px; }
  .hero-form { max-width: 550px; }
  .hero-metric { display: none; }
  .intro-video, .lessons, .method, .audience, .final-cta { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .intro-video { gap: 50px; }
  .lessons { gap: 50px; }
  .lessons-intro { position: static; }
  .problem { gap: 40px; }
  .stage-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .stage-grid article:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; }
  .stage-grid article:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .guide-content { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .founders-photo { min-height: 0; max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .guide-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .final-cta { gap: 45px; }
  .final-cta .delera-form-shell { max-width: 520px; }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .topbar { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .12em; }
  .site-header { height: 76px; padding: 0 20px; }
  .brand img { width: 145px; }
  .button-small { font-size: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; }
  .button-small svg { display: none; }
  .course-banner { margin-top: 20px; padding: 0 20px; }
